title: CASI: Credit Assignment via Set Intervention for Agentic Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.20293v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models increasingly generate multiple retrieval actions jointly, while downstream systems often provide only one reward for the resulting set. Broadcasting this reward provides a valid score-function gradient estimator for the expected set-level objective, but does not determine a coalition-dependent within-set attribution. We introduce CASI (Credit Assignment via Set Intervention for Agentic Retrieval), which constructs the missing counterfactual information through snapshot-grounded set intervention: generate and retrieve once, hold replayable snapshot components fixed, and evaluate alternative subsets under common conditions. Shapley aggregation converts these marginals into within-set credit, which bounded zero-sum advantage shaping incorporates into policy optimization. translated_title: CASI：基于集合干预的智能体检索信用分配
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型越来越多地联合生成多个检索动作，而下游系统通常只对最终结果集合提供一个奖励。广播这一奖励虽然能为期望的集合级目标提供有效的得分函数梯度估计器，但无法确定依赖于联盟结构的集合内归因。我们提出了CASI（Credit Assignment via Set Intervention for Agentic Retrieval，基于集合干预的智能体检索信用分配），它通过基于快照的集合干预来构建缺失的反事实信息：只需生成并检索一次，保持可重放的快照组件固定，并在共同条件下评估不同的替代子集。Shapley聚合将这些边际贡献转化为集合内信用，并通过有界零和优势整形将其融入策略优化。当 m >= 4 时，单例、留一和全集端点通常不足以确定Shapley分配；在集合值可加的情况下，额外的联盟……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CASI方法，通过基于快照的集合干预构建反事实信息并结合Shapley聚合，解决了智能体检索中多个联合生成的检索动作的集合内信用分配问题，从而提升策略优化效果。
en_tdlr: CASI addresses within-set credit assignment for jointly generated retrieval actions in agentic retrieval by constructing counterfactual information via snapshot-grounded set intervention and Shapley aggregation, incorporated into policy optimization through bounded zero-sum advantage shaping.
